fix(effects-feel): read a strip's text cells off the render its colours come from (rich-effects-feel-tupd)

A seam is told by what drew it, not by its glyph: the strip's joiner stamps
every seam cell with an owner, so an ASCII lead that draws nothing no longer
shifts the text set one column off the colours it is matched against.

fix(pretty): quote an object key that is not a name or an index, as Rich reprs it (rich-pretty-h3uh) (#344)
